description: One entry per attempt directory, and per record set aside under discarded/, of the eight runs whose records the committed arrays under results/ summarize, with whether the committed array holds the attempt. Attempt directories are under ~/.local/state/foe/cross-harness/<run>/attempts/<task>/<arm>/<attempt>.

claimed_total.finding: No set of local records that a results document or a run defines sums to 138. The eight archived runs hold 120 records; adding the 6 discarded records and the 1 interrupted attempt directory gives 127. Unions of unrelated whole runs can reach 138 by arithmetic alone, so a sum identifies nothing, and the closed pull request that stated 138 named no list of attempts. The claim has no supporting records.
